static_traits.name: Zhou Cheng
static_traits.family_status: Adopted into a family with six siblings;adoptive father works at HP,Mother cares for the home;good relationships with siblings
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with siblings,but negative outlook on the future affects interactions with others;has family to talk to but has not yet shared worries
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,fairly cooperative,neutral tone;able to describe Anxiety and worries specifically,but tends to focus on negative outcomes

basic_info.main_problem: I hold a negative attitude toward the future,feeling overwhelmed and fearing the Unknown.I often catastrophize and jump to conclusions,negating positive factors,leading to Anxiety and Fear;these feelings make it hard to see the point of planning for the future.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear and Anxiety about the future have begun affecting my daily life and mental health,so I hope to address these issues through counseling.
growth_experiences: Grew up after adoption in a family with six siblings;adoptive father works at HP,Mother manages the household;good relationships with siblings,this family structure and supportive atmosphere forming an important early-life background.

core_beliefs: The future is uncontrollable and will surely become terrible
I will become a burden to my family
No matter what I do,it will ultimately fail or collapse

special_situations.event: When thinking about long-term goals and future planning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the future cannot be guaranteed controllable and certain,it means I will fail,and all effort have no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding detailed planning,distracting oneself through Work or hobbies to not think about the future
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do,it will all collapse in the end

special_situations.event: When hearing news of economic downturn or layoffs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the external environment is risky,I will surely be laid off and then cannot find Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously worrying and mentally preparing for the worst,but not discussing with others to avoid being seen as exaggerating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will soon be Unemployment,and then cannot find Work either

special_situations.event: When the boss gives positive feedback and the company's operations are stable
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only completely certain and zero-risk guarantees represent true stability and safety
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or belittling positive information, deliberately focusing on potential negative possibilities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This good news does not count,my future is still terrible

special_situations.event: When with family and thinking about sharing own worries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express Anxiety,I will be seen as exaggerating and burdening the family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying Silence,not seeking support to avoid burdening others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am exaggerating; I will become a burden to the family

core_conflict.wish: Longing for safety,to be understood and accepted by family,not to be a burden
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of losing control and failing, being seen as exaggerating, or bringing burden to family
defense_goal: Maintaining relational calm and self-security through Repression and avoiding sharing
Turning attention to Work and hobbies to temporarily reduce Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable person who might become a burden
object_relations.object_representation: Family/others who may judge him or be dragged down by him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether worries about the future are shared with family,or when Anxiety topics arise in front of family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that expressing it will be seen as 'exaggerating' and will make the family bear a burden (transference: fear of being evaluated)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding going into detail,use vague and generalized expressions,quickly turning back to general worries or practical topics,keeping an even tone and restrained emotions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to provide concrete evidence or realistic basis for 'Unemployment' worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating macro-level uncertainty with inevitable personal victimhood,using external information to prove the rationality of inner Fear
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes economic data and news stories, using rational analysis to replace emotional expression; neutral, organized tone, downplaying subjective emotional words.

manifestations: Feeling the future is bleak,'what is the point?'
Difficulty seeing the value of planning for the future,tending to negate positive aspects
outcomes: Decreased drive,difficulty engaging in present tasks

manifestations: Though having family support resources,not yet sharing one's own Fear and worries
Worries about being misunderstood or seen as exaggerating; chooses silence
outcomes: Disconnected from Social support,inner Increased sense of loneliness
Persistent Anxiety,unable to gain reparative experiences in relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not discussing Fear and Anxiety about the future with family
Turning the urge to express and seek help into self-Repression and Distraction(staying busy)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries about being considered 'too dramatic', excessively concerned about others' evaluations and self-limiting expression
Keeps cautious in interactions and reduces emotional exposure

positive_force: Good relationships with six siblings,having potential family support resources
The boss's recent positive feedback and the reality signals of company stability
Willing to seek counseling and open to trying reality-testing techniques
negative_force: Attention dominated by cognitive biases such as catastrophizing,predicting the future and mental filtering
Negating positive information,difficulty integrating a balanced perspective
Avoiding and repressing emotional expression,reducing available Social support
Overly concerned with others' evaluations, worries about becoming a burden, leading to restricted communication
Persistent anxiety affecting focus and daily functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic worrying about the future and repeatedly rehearsing worst-case scenarios
antecedent: When thinking about long-term goals and plans
When hearing news about economic downturn or layoffs
Involuntarily zoning out with worry while doing daily tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Low tolerance for uncertainty and Fear of failure/becoming a burden,driven by long-standing negative cognitive patterns(catastrophizing,predicting the future,mental filtering)
target_behavior.function: Escaping highly uncomfortable Anxiety and uncertainty,gaining the short-term illusion of control of 'preparing for the worst'
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty focusing on current tasks and responsibilities,daily life disrupted,Anxiety maintained or worsened,future planning avoided

target_behavior.behavior: Not communicating with family about one's own Fear and worries regarding the future
antecedent: Thinking of sharing worries when with family
When asked whether Anxiety and Fear have been discussed with family
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being seen as exaggerating,worry about burdening the family,tending to repress emotions to maintain surface relational calm
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated and feeling guilty, maintaining superficial harmony and self-security
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support,inner Increased sense of loneliness,persistent Anxiety
